messages:
sales_amy: FYI — NimbusMedia just asked for an adaptive rate lift for an upcoming weekend marketing surge. They want ~200 req/s for 48h (current baseline ~10 req/s). They said they'll accept temporary billing addendum. Can we triage? :eyes:

maria-sd: Sending to fraud screening and SRE for perf impact. sales_amy, can you share which endpoints and avg token counts? small snippet works.

sales_amy: Endpoint is `/v1/generate` (chat), avg 350 tokens per response. Quick example payload: ```{\n  "model": "redwood-gpt-2b",\n  "prompt": "...",\n  "max_tokens": 350\n}```

abuse-scan-bot: automated-scan result: pattern=steady high-volume, repeated IPs from 6 ranges, entropy low. score=0.62 (medium). Flagging for manual review.

maria-sd: Noted. tagging @jonah-pm for product decision (any policy constraints for temporary/per-tenant overrides?). Also @tara-eng for technical feasibility.

jonah-pm: Quick notes from PM side: we can approve conditional short-term uplifts if fraud cleared and SRE confirms latency/cost controls. Need acceptance criteria before approval: 1) per-tenant rate override with TTL, 2) canary rollout (10% first hour), 3) automated rollback triggers (error rate, latency, cost delta), 4) billing addendum signed. If all good, this goes to backlog as "customer burst: NimbusMedia" with high priority.

tara-eng: Engineering feasibility: we can provision a per-tenant override in <6h as a config flag + routing rule. Canary can be handled by traffic-split in runtime. Rollback hooks: we can wire alerts for 5xx% > 3% or p95 latency > 2s. Need SRE to run capacity check for us-west2/GPU pool.

eli: I'll coordinate billing and generate a 48h addendum draft. Sales confirms they will sign. Also opening an intake ticket to track cost approval.

ops-bot: capacity-check job queued (job_id=cap-1923456800). Please wait for SRE assessment.

maria-sd: Fraud team doing manual checks now (logins, token reuse, pattern analysis). ETA ~30m.

abuse-scan-bot: supplemental check: user-agent diversity low, repeat prompt hashes high. Still medium risk. 

jonah-pm: If fraud is medium but customer is cooperative (signed addendum + identity proof), product's decision: allow time-limited uplift with tighter observability. Need SRE sign-off before flip.

tara-eng: SRE check completed: projected p95 under uplift = 1.6s in us-west2 with current pool, no immediate OOM risk. We recommend canary 10% -> 50% -> full over 3 hours, with automated rollback on triggers above.

maria-sd: Fraud team cleared at 1923457000 after verifying account ownership and absence of credential stuffing. Low signal of abuse after manual review.

eli: Addendum uploaded: https://docs.internal/redwood/nimbus-burst-addendum (signed). Billing OK to proceed.

jonah-pm: Decision: approve conditional 48h adaptive uplift. Action items: 1) Tara: create override + canary deploy (ETA 2h). 2) Ops: enable automated rollback triggers. 3) Support: monitor logs + be on-call for the window. 4) Sales/Billing: confirm addendum (done). Postmortem required within 72h of end.

ops-bot: canary deploy initiated at 1923457025 (10% traffic -> us-west2). Monitoring hooks live.

sales_amy: Customer notified of schedule and monitoring. They're pleased. :thumbsup:

maria-sd: I'll keep watching logs and escalate if anything odd. Thanks everyone.

jonah-pm: Moving this into product backlog as `customer-burst/nimbus-2024-03` with labels [customer-request, high-priority, temporary-uplift]. Closing thread once postmortem scheduled.
